title: Hereticon founder's startup to reverse engineer UFOs with quantum computing
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Hereticon founder's startup to reverse engineer UFOs with quantum computing, about 2022 at Hereticon, Miami, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There's a founder here at Hereticon, who maybe is one of the most heretical thinkers here. He's trying to reverse engineer UFOs with, uh, quantum computing.

plain: At Hereticon, a 2022 gathering in Miami for people with unpopular or forbidden ideas, there was a company founder trying to work out how UFOs function by using quantum computers, a new kind of very powerful computer, according to Jesse Michels. Michels mentions it himself while at the event, calling the founder perhaps "one of the most heretical thinkers here", without giving a name. It is told to show how far some people are taking the subject.
